clips.title: The story
paras: Along Lake Al'Ameth, Timberling Sprouts take root already touched by corruption. Night elf wardens pull them before they grow into aggressive timberlings.

Timberlings are plant spirits bound to Teldrassil's natural vitality. Along Lake Al'Ameth, the night elves find seedlings that sprout tainted and aggressive instead of healthy and in harmony with the wild. The young sprouts seem beyond cleansing or natural healing, so the caretakers gather and destroy them. They hope to stop hostile timberlings from spreading across the fragile boughs of the newly planted World Tree.
